name: Typeface
summary: Use the approved GOV.UK typeface only for eligible services and configure an appropriate alternative for services outside the GOV.UK proposition.
rules: A service on the service.gov.uk subdomain must use GDS Transport through the official GOV.UK Frontend asset setup.
A publicly available service on another subdomain must configure an alternative typeface using the official unbranded GOV.UK Frontend guidance.
Use regular weight 400 for body text and bold weight 700 for emphasis and headings unless a component specifies otherwise.
Use system fonts for print output as configured by GOV.UK Frontend.
accessibility: Do not prevent users from resizing text or substituting fonts through browser and assistive-technology settings.
Test fallback fonts for reflow, clipping and control sizing because their metrics differ from GDS Transport.
Use semantic emphasis and heading elements rather than font weight alone to communicate structure.
restrictions: GDS Transport is restricted to services on the GOV.UK domain; this package names the typeface for guidance but does not distribute, embed or license the font files.
Do not copy font files from GOV.UK pages or from another service.
